name: Meter
summary: A styled native <meter> that shows a measurement in a known range, green, amber or red against the low, high and optimum marks.
description: Use a meter for a level: disk usage, quota, a score. It is not for progress through a task; use a progress bar for that.

states.description: Where the good, middling and poor zones sit. The browser picks the colour: success, warning or danger.

a11y: Name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby; the native element reports its value to screen readers.
The colour alone does not say whether a level is good or bad; show the number or a word next to it when that matters.
Text inside <meter> is a fallback for browsers without support.

examples.title: Three zones
examples.description: The same low, high and optimum marks with three values.
examples.html: Disk usage, 32% 32% Disk usage, 82% 82% Disk usage, 96% 96%
